ns2:course.label: General Relativity II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of PHYS 515 with emphasis on applications to astrophysics and cosmology. Topics include: relativistic stars, gravitational collapse, black holes, gravitational waves, numerical relativity, and cosmology. Same as ASTR 516. Offered in alternate Spring terms. Prerequisite: PHYS 515 or consent of instructor.
